name: com.zabaglione.lookingglass.viewweave.urp
description: Self-contained unofficial ViewWeave URP package for Unity 6.

samples.description: Ready-to-open URP scene with a black background, animated primitives and a configured Bridge Rig for macOS Metal or Windows D3D11/D3D12.
Optional Windows Bridge demo scene for URP; the Bridge Worker supports D3D11 and D3D12, and standard Cube and Box scenes need no sample import.
